snippet.title: Pecado_Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4104520/PECADO/


PECADO is a first-person folk horror and survival game set in the decaying, oppressive countryside of 1990s rural Spain. Players navigate a dark narrative dominated by religion, violence, and silence, forced to carefully manage limited resources while uncovering grim secrets. To survive the sinister presences that stalk the environment, you must master stealth, know when to flee, and hold onto your faith to maintain your sanity.
